Technical Analysis Report · 技术分析报告

Common Prosperity Index (CPI) Prediction System

A pure-NumPy 2D-CNN + LSTM model that predicts the next-year Common Prosperity Index for 31 Chinese provinces. This report covers its design philosophy, mathematical foundations, statistical methods, and algorithmic patterns.

共同富裕指数（CPI）预测系统 —— 一个基于纯 NumPy 的 2D-CNN + LSTM 模型，预测中国 31 个省份次年的共同富裕指数。本报告梳理其设计思路、数学基础、统计方式与算法模式。

31 Provinces · 8 Indicators 2013–2023 · 341 samples 7,281 parameters Best val loss 0.003717
Language / 语言

1. Project Overview 项目概述

This project builds an end-to-end machine-learning pipeline that turns a province–year panel of socioeconomic indicators into a single composite "Common Prosperity Index" (CPI) and then learns to forecast next year's CPI for every province using a compact deep network.

本项目构建了一套端到端的机器学习流程：将「省份 × 年份」的社会经济指标面板数据整合为 一个综合的「共同富裕指数」(CPI)，再用一个轻量级深度网络 预测各省次年 CPI。

The pipeline consists of four stages:

流程包含四个阶段：

  1. Data acquisition — fetch real indicators from the National Bureau of Statistics (国家统计局) via akshare (fetch_real_data.py), with a synthetic fallback (generate_data.py).
  2. 数据获取 — 通过 akshare 从国家统计局抓取真实指标（fetch_real_data.py），另有合成数据兜底（generate_data.py）。
  3. Index construction — normalize indicators (min–max) and aggregate them into the CPI using the entropy weight method.
  4. 指数构建 — 对指标做 min–max 归一化，并用 熵值法 聚合为 CPI。
  5. Model training — reshape sliding windows into 2D multi-channel inputs and train a 2D-CNN + LSTM regressor (train_cnn.py).
  6. 模型训练 — 将滑动窗口重构为二维多通道输入，训练 2D-CNN + LSTM 回归器（train_cnn.py）。
  7. Inference — predict next-year CPI for all provinces and rank them (predict.py).
  8. 推理预测 — 预测所有省份次年 CPI 并排名（predict.py）。

2. Design Philosophy 设计思路

The central design decision is to treat a tabular time series as a 2D "image". A sliding window of T years × K indicators forms a grid; convolution then has a natural meaning: it compares neighbouring cells in both the time and indicator dimensions, explicitly encoding local contrast rather than relying on the network to discover it.

核心设计决策是把表格化时间序列当作一张 二维「图像」。一个 T 年 × K 指标的 滑动窗口构成一个网格；此时卷积就有了天然含义：它在 时间 与 指标 两个方向上比较 相邻单元格，显式编码 局部对比，而不是让网络自己去发现。

2.1 Three-channel input construction 三通道输入构造

Each raw (T, K) window is expanded into (T, K, 3) with three channels (build_2d_channels in train_cnn.py):

每个原始 (T, K) 窗口被扩展为 (T, K, 3) 三通道（train_cnn.py 中的 build_2d_channels）：

Channel · 通道Meaning · 含义Definition · 定义
Channel 0Level / 水平z[t,k] — standardized indicator value
Channel 1Time contrast / 时间对比z[t,k] − z[t−1,k]
Channel 2Indicator contrast / 指标对比z[t,k] − z[t,k−1]

2.2 Why CNN + LSTM (not plain CNN) 为何 CNN + LSTM（而非纯 CNN）

A 2D CNN captures local spatial structure (adjacent-year and adjacent-indicator relationships), but it has a limited receptive field along time. An LSTM stacked on top models long-range temporal dependencies across the whole window, which is essential for extrapolating trends. This is the classic spatial feature extractor + temporal sequence model pattern.

2D CNN 负责捕捉 局部空间结构（相邻年份、相邻指标的关系），但其在时间轴上的感受野有限。 在其之上叠加 LSTM 则可建模整个窗口的 长程时序依赖，这对趋势外推至关重要。 这是经典的「空间特征提取器 + 时序序列模型」范式。

2.3 Pure NumPy, no framework 纯 NumPy、无框架

The entire forward/backward pass (Conv2D, MaxPool, LSTM, Dense, Adam) is implemented from scratch in NumPy. This keeps the model ultra-lightweight (7,281 params), CPU-friendly, dependency-free (only numpy + pandas), and fully transparent for study.

前向/反向传播（Conv2D、MaxPool、LSTM、Dense、Adam）全部用 NumPy 从零实现。 这使得模型 极致轻量（7,281 个参数）、CPU 友好、零依赖（仅 numpy + pandas）， 且完全透明、便于学习。

3. Data & Indicators 数据与指标

The composite index aggregates 8 indicators, of which 7 are positive (higher = better) and 1 is negative (higher = worse). Real data is fetched from the National Bureau of Statistics (2013–2023).

综合指数聚合了 8 个指标，其中 7 个为 正向（越大越好）、1 个为 负向（越大越差）。 真实数据来自国家统计局（2013–2023）。

Indicator · 指标Direction · 方向Raw definition · 原始口径
GDP_per_capita 人均GDPpositive 正向人均地区生产总值 (元/人)
Disposable_income 可支配收入positive 正向全体居民人均可支配收入 (元)
Urbanization_rate 城镇化率positive 正向城镇人口 ÷ 年末常住人口
Education_ratio 教育水平positive 正向每十万人口高等教育在校生数 (人)
Social_security 社会保障positive 正向城镇职工养老保险参保 ÷ 常住人口
Urban_rural_income_ratio 城乡收入比negative 负向城镇可支配收入 ÷ 农村可支配收入
Environment_index 环境指数positive 正向建成区绿化覆盖率 (%)
Infrastructure_index 基础设施positive 正向互联网宽带接入用户 ÷ 常住人口
Data integrity
数据真实性

Derived ratios (urbanization, social-security coverage, broadband penetration, urban–rural gap) are all computed from genuine NBS figures — no values are fabricated. Missing values are filled per-province with linear interpolation plus forward/backward fill.

所有派生比例（城镇化率、社保覆盖率、宽带渗透率、城乡收入比）均由国家统计局真实原始数据计算得出——无任何编造。缺失值按省份做线性插值 + 前向/后向填充。

4. Mathematical Foundations 数学基础

4.1 Min–max normalization 极差归一化

For a positive indicator (higher is better):

对 正向 指标（越大越好）：

x' = (x − xmin) / (xmax − xmin)

For a negative indicator (lower is better), the direction is reversed:

对 负向 指标（越小越好），方向取反：

x' = (xmax − x) / (xmax − xmin)

4.2 Entropy weight method (熵值法) 熵值法

The CPI is a weighted sum of normalized indicators, where weights are derived from the information entropy of each indicator. Higher dispersion → lower entropy → higher weight.

CPI 是归一化指标的加权和，权重由各指标的 信息熵 决定。离散度越大 → 熵越小 → 权重越高。

pij = x'ij / Σi x'ij   # proportion of sample i under indicator j
ej = −k Σi pij ln pij,   k = 1 / ln(n)   # information entropy (0·ln0 = 0)
dj = 1 − ej   # divergence coefficient 差异系数
wj = dj / Σj dj   # normalized weight 权重
CPIi = Σj wj · x'ij   # composite score 综合得分

4.3 Input standardization (z-score) 输入标准化（z-score）

Before feeding the network, features and targets are standardized using statistics computed from the training split only (no data leakage):

输入网络前，特征与目标用 仅来自训练集 的统计量做标准化（避免数据泄漏）：

z = (x − μ) / (σ + ε),   ε = 1e−8

4.4 Convolution (cross-correlation) 卷积（互相关）

(X ∗ W)[i, j, o] = Σp,q,c X[i+p, j+q, c] · W[p, q, c, o] + bo

4.5 Activations 激活函数

ReLU(x) = max(0, x)
σ(x) = 1 / (1 + e−x)   # sigmoid (gate activations)
tanh(x) = (ex − e−x) / (ex + e−x)

4.6 LSTM gates LSTM 门控

ft = σ(Wf[ht−1, xt] + bf)   # forget gate 遗忘门
it = σ(Wi[ht−1, xt] + bi)   # input gate 输入门
ot = σ(Wo[ht−1, xt] + bo)   # output gate 输出门
gt = tanh(Wg[ht−1, xt] + bg)   # candidate 候选值
ct = ft ⊙ ct−1 + it ⊙ gt,   ht = ot ⊙ tanh(ct)

4.7 Loss & optimizer 损失与优化器

MSE = (1/N) Σ (ŷ − y)²
mt = β₁mt−1 + (1−β₁)gt,   vt = β₂vt−1 + (1−β₂)gt²   # Adam, β₁=0.9, β₂=0.999
m̂t = mt/(1−β₁t),   v̂t = vt/(1−β₂t)   # bias correction
θt = θt−1 − lr · m̂t / (√v̂t + ε)
lr(epoch) = lr0 / (1 + 0.01·(epoch−1))   # learning-rate decay

5. Statistical Methods 统计方式

5.1 Entropy weighting 熵权法

Information entropy measures how informative each indicator is: an indicator whose values are nearly identical across all province–year samples carries little discriminating information (high entropy → low weight), while one with wide dispersion discriminates strongly (low entropy → high weight). The resulting weights are objective — no subjective judgment is involved.

信息熵 度量每个指标的信息量：若某指标在所有省份-年份样本上几乎相同，则区分能力弱（高熵 → 低权重）； 若离散度大，则区分能力强（低熵 → 高权重）。由此得到的权重是 客观的——不掺杂主观判断。

5.2 Train / validation split (leakage-free) 训练/验证划分（无泄漏）

Windows are randomly shuffled and split 80% train / 20% validation. Crucially, the normalization statistics (mean/std for features and target) are computed only on the training split, then applied to the validation set — preventing information leakage from the validation fold.

窗口随机打乱后按 80% 训练 / 20% 验证 划分。关键点：归一化统计量（特征与目标的均值/标准差） 只由训练集计算，再应用到验证集，避免验证集信息泄漏。

5.3 Evaluation metrics 评估指标

Metric · 指标Formula · 公式Purpose · 用途
MSE(1/N) Σ (ŷ − y)²training/validation loss 训练/验证损失
MAE(1/N) Σ |ŷ − y|interpretable error 直观误差
R²1 − Σ(y−ŷ)² / Σ(y−ȳ)²explained variance 方差解释率

6. Algorithm Patterns 算法模式

6.1 Sliding-window supervised learning 滑动窗口监督学习

The time series is converted into a supervised regression problem: for each province, a window of T consecutive years of the 8 indicators becomes the input, and the CPI of the next year is the target (load_data in train_cnn.py, default seq_len = 5).

时间序列被转换为监督回归问题：对每个省份，连续 T 年的 8 个指标构成输入，下一年 的 CPI 作为目标 （train_cnn.py 的 load_data，默认 seq_len = 5）。

6.2 2D-CNN feature extraction 2D-CNN 特征提取

Two convolutional blocks extract local spatial features, each: Conv2D(3×3, same) → ReLU → MaxPool(1×2). Pooling is applied only over the indicator axis (halving K twice) so the time axis is fully preserved for the LSTM.

两个卷积块提取局部空间特征，每个块：Conv2D(3×3, same) → ReLU → MaxPool(1×2)。池化 只作用于指标轴（K 连续减半），完整保留时间轴供 LSTM 使用。

6.3 LSTM sequence modeling LSTM 序列建模

The pooled feature map is reshaped into a per-time sequence (T, seq_feat) and passed through an LSTM with 24 hidden units; the final hidden state is fed to a regression head.

池化后的特征图被重塑为逐时间步序列 (T, seq_feat)，输入含 24 个隐藏单元的 LSTM；其末时刻隐藏状态送入回归头。

6.4 Backpropagation & BPTT 反向传播与沿时反向传播

Gradients flow backward through the Dense head, then through the LSTM via Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT, iterating time steps in reverse), and finally through the two conv/pool blocks using transposed (de)convolution and max-unpooling.

梯度沿 Dense 头反向，随后经 沿时反向传播（BPTT） 穿过 LSTM（逆序迭代时间步），最后经转置卷积与最大反池化穿过两个卷积/池化块。

6.5 Regularization & optimization 正则化与优化

  • Adam optimizer with bias correction and per-parameter adaptive learning rates.
  • Adam 优化器，带偏差校正与逐参数自适应学习率。
  • Inverted dropout (rate 0.15) on the LSTM output, applied only during training.
  • LSTM 输出上的 反向 dropout（率 0.15），仅在训练时生效。
  • Learning-rate decay lr/(1 + 0.01·(epoch−1)).
  • 学习率衰减 lr/(1 + 0.01·(epoch−1))。
  • Best-model selection: a checkpoint is saved every epoch; the lowest-validation-loss model is kept as the final model.
  • 最佳模型选择：每个 epoch 保存检查点，保留验证损失最低者作为最终模型。
  • Reproducibility: default seed is drawn fresh each run (genuine run-to-run variance); a fixed seed can be passed via --seed for exact reproduction.
  • 可复现性：默认每次运行使用新随机种子（真实波动）；可通过 --seed 固定种子以精确复现。

Quick start
快速开始

setup.bat (creates venv + installs numpy/pandas) → run_training.bat (trains the model) → run_prediction.bat (predicts next year). Or run directly with Python: python generate_data.py → python train_cnn.py → python predict.py.

setup.bat（创建虚拟环境并安装 numpy/pandas）→ run_training.bat（训练模型）→ run_prediction.bat（预测次年）。也可直接用 Python： python generate_data.py → python train_cnn.py → python predict.py。

10. Conclusion 结论

This project cleanly separates index construction (statistical: min–max normalization + entropy weighting) from prediction (algorithmic: 2D-CNN + LSTM). Its key insight — turning a tabular panel into a multi-channel 2D grid to let convolution capture local contrast — combined with an LSTM for temporal dependencies, yields a compact, transparent, dependency-free forecaster with strong extrapolation on 31-province data.

本项目将 指数构建（统计方法：min–max 归一化 + 熵值法）与 预测（算法模式：2D-CNN + LSTM）清晰解耦。其核心洞见——把表格面板重构为多通道二维网格、 让卷积捕捉局部对比，再叠加 LSTM 建模时序依赖——得到一个紧凑、透明、零依赖的预测器， 在 31 省数据上具备良好的趋势外推能力。
